name: Fly.io
summary: Fly.io runs applications as Fly Machines: Firecracker microVMs that start quickly, are controlled through a REST API, and can be placed in many regions close to users. Machines are billed per second while running and can stop or suspend when idle. In 2026 the company made Sprites, disposable agent computers with durable filesystems, its core focus while keeping Machines and the app platform.
facts: Stop or suspend; stopped Machines billed only for rootfs
Per second while running; shared-cpu-1x 256MB from $2.19/mo
goodFor: Always-on agent processes in a real VM
Per-user or per-task VMs via the Machines API
Running close to users in many regions
watchOut: More ops work than serverless platforms
